description: This PHP class, LeaveLeaveEntitlementDecorator, provides an object-oriented interface for managing LeaveLeaveEntitlement entities within the OrangeHRM personnel management system. It utilizes traits and references to other entity objects such as Leave and LeaveEntitlement to set related data, acting as a decorator or helper for entity operations within the system.
